section.8: The Book of Prayer - Two Eids

8.name_native: The Book of Prayer - Two Eids

hadiths.text: Umm Atiyya reported:We were commanded to go out as well as the hidden away ladies and those unmarried. She said menstruating women were to come out amongst you, but remain behind people and pronounce takbir (Allah-o-Akbar) along with them
